whatsNew.en-US:
In the Prompts tab, select several prompts to favorite, move to a category, share or delete them all at once.

Duplicate a prompt from its long-press menu to make your own version and keep the original.

Your sort and filter choices are now remembered, and Vibe Prompts can be sorted by Most Used.
whatsNew.zh-Hans:
在 Prompts 标签页中可一次选择多个提示词，批量收藏、移至分类、分享或删除。

在长按菜单中为提示词创建副本，即可在保留原版的同时打造属于自己的版本。

排序和筛选选项现在会被记住，Vibe 提示词也可以按使用次数排序。
